question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you enjoy being the Social Chair if it existed in your school?
Which couple do you like best?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm willing to offer you something in return...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoever raises the most money by the end of tomorrow will earn my endorsement for Social Chair!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yep! Think how much more people will want to vote for you when the President is behind you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, in that case...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: May the best girl win...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, may the best girl...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was talking about `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was talking about [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The cupcakes I'm bringing to this thing are going to be the `best` cupcakes anyone's `ever` tasted...
nodes.text_bbcode: The cupcakes I'm bringing to this thing are going to be the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] cupcakes anyone's [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] tasted...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't go up against me, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because you will get `burned.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you will get [color=#3b78e2][i]burned.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'Unfair'?! 'Unfair' is getting a pop quiz in history when no one's been paying attention in class!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'Unfair' is flunking your driver's test the day before your parents buy you a new car!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `'Unfair'` is the saleslady at the store refusing to honor your 20% off coupon because you came one day `too late!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]'Unfair'[/i][/color] is the saleslady at the store refusing to honor your 20% off coupon because you came one day [color=#3b78e2][i]too late![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The way I see it, I'm doing you two a `favor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The way I see it, I'm doing you two a [color=#3b78e2][i]favor.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This competition is going to be about more than just looks and popularity...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's going to come down to who can throw the best events in spite of low funding, strict administration, and student apathy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is your chance to prove yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, it's going to be a little challenging to pull everything together so quickly, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm glad you're aware of your time...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But Social Chair is going to have to be really good at getting things together at the last minute.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's exactly what you said... A challenging job.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's more than challenging! It's `unfair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's more than challenging! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]unfair![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How am I supposed to get the servants to pull everything together on time?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I `look` like I care?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do I [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] like I care?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look at this as a chance for you to prove yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Unfair?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I guess it's not like you'll be seeing each other all the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually... We're kind of grabbing lunch together today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, there's no harm in us hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not... But be careful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will.
Taylor approaches $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! My office! Now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did I do something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha, no. I've just always wanted to say that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But seriously... Are you coming or not?
A few minutes later, Taylor, $ZOE, and Paige sit inside the office of the Student Council.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Taylor... You look Presidential.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So what are we here for? Is $ZOE resigning from the competition for Social Chair because she realizes she can't win?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that why you didn't even bother to show up to my party?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: By the way, everyone `loved` the trampoline room in my house...
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, everyone [color=#3b78e2][i]loved[/i][/color] the trampoline room in my house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least I don't have to use gimmicks to make people think I'm competent.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well...
Taylor clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is fun...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I didn't call you both here to cat fight.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I called you in because if either of you want to be taken seriously as candidates for Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'll help me out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure. What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want to make the Halloween Dance the biggest dance of the semester. It should be as big a deal as Prom!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Naturally, I want to put the most trustworthy and capable person in charge of planning it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So I'm giving both of you a test. Each of you will be in charge of running a booth for Taylor's First Fundraiser!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do we have to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There will be three booths for students to visit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm organizing a free makeover table, but I want one booth for baked goods and one booth for some kind of entertainment.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know that it should be pretty clear who's going to run which...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I'd be `happy` to take over the `baked goods` booth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]happy[/i][/color] to take over the [color=#3b78e2][i]baked goods[/i][/color] booth!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... That's usually what I do...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Better buck up. This is your chance to amuse people for once.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE, I guess you're doing entertainment.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No pressure, but...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If people don't enjoy it, you'll regret it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll do my best... How long until the fundraiser?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's tomorrow after school. But all your materials should be on campus by lunch, so we can set them up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything has to be here by tomorrow? But that's really...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He'll only be here for a week.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You two could get back together and talk yourselves into doing the long-distance thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! Remember those four months where I tried really hard to forget Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember all the shopping trips we went on, so nothing in my closet reminded me of him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember when I cut my hair?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how about all those times I had to resist calling him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How could I forget?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really think that doing all those things didn't mean anything to me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That I'd suddenly forget all about the person I became?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Honestly, I don't think Howard will be a problem.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just good friends who enjoy making banners together and planning parties...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And spending time together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's the entire reason why you went searching for Owen right before the most important football game of the year?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! You stand up for the people you care about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh. If you ask me, you're doing a `lot` for just being `friends.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh. If you ask me, you're doing a [color=#3b78e2][i]lot[/i][/color] for just being [color=#3b78e2][i]friends.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you want me to say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going through a lot right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry. I'm just worried. Maybe it is better for you to deal with one problem at a time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not even sure what we are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm not going to ask any questions until...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Until I'm less confused.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's probably wise...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't think it's fair to think about Owen when Howard's back in town.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I get it. One problem at a time?
As Howard walks away, something inside her aches.
She shakes her head and gets inside her car.
The next day...
$ZOE and Sam are at their lockers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Spill.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Spill' what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't give me that. You snuck out of the house really early this morning...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which is funny because you came home pretty late last night.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know it wasn't because you were at Paige's dessert buffet...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige had a dessert buffet? Ugh, she's so rich. Please say she didn't have a photo booth...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, just peacocks, swan boats, and a gazebo. And... Maybe a trampoline room...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But don't think you're getting out of answering! What happened between you and Howard last night? I'm `dying` to know.
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't think you're getting out of answering! What happened between you and Howard last night? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]dying[/i][/color] to know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing happened!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because that's not suspicious at all...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What could possibly have happened with Howard?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... You two realize how much you missed each other and make out all night?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that did `not` happen. We just talked. Like we were really good friends.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] happen. We just talked. Like we were really good friends.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Nice' is good. 'Nice' is what you wanted, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then why do you look so bummed out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Seeing Howard after all this time brings up so many buried feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's reminding me of everything we used to have with each other. It makes me wonder what we could have had...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Don't walk down this path again, cuz.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because it was ugly the first time, and it'll be worse the second.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what about the football guy? Owen? What about him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen and I are...
$ZOE leans in to hug him. He hugs her back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not sure what we are... But this feels right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good night, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good night, $ZOE.
$ZOE sticks out her hand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A handshake?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're giving me the 'I don't know you well enough to hug you' handshake?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry! It's just... It's been a while.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right.
He takes $ZOE's hand, gives it a firm shake, then turns away.
$ZOE freezes, unsure what to do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'll see you around...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! I'll see you around.
$ZOE waves good-bye.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe I just `waved` at him! That was really dumb!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, uh, Kingston sounds pretty amazing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it sounds like you're meeting a lot of new people...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you... Are you dating anyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But, honestly, I've just been putting all my efforts into my campaign for Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Social Chair? I thought that was Melissa Tancredo's job.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She totally blew the budget, so now her position's open. I'm running against Paige, and it is `tough.`
nodes.text_bbcode: She totally blew the budget, so now her position's open. I'm running against Paige, and it is [color=#3b78e2][i]tough.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I bet. I get to plan some of the Kingston Kings' events. It's a lot of work...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But seriously... I'm on a break.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wouldn't your school break be a little later? Like, around Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it's Kingston's way of celebrating the, uh... Vernal Equinox.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of weird... But hey. East Coast schools, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Those East Coast schools are all so... Strange?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha... I just meant that Kingston has peculiar traditions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I bet...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like, there's one legend in the school...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: About this `secret` society that all the elite members become part of.
nodes.text_bbcode: About this [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society that all the elite members become part of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool!
$ZOE feels her stomach knot up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't like lying to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what else am I supposed to say?
Howard relaxes back into his chair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's... Too bad...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: With cheerleading and all the AP classes I'm taking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I barely have time to breathe, much less date.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, yeah.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the truth at least...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you have thought about dating someone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, yes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Things are... Different this year.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Well, there are girls at Kingston...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can only imagine...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I haven't met any girl worth spending time with...
Howard looks at $ZOE with an emotion she can't identify.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about you? Have you started dating anyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...
$ZOE's mind wanders to the football field an hour earlier...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So $ZOE, now that this is all over...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you think we could finally get some time to just hang out together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Because I'd really like to get to know you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?
$ZOE focuses on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... No, I haven't...

options.label: There's no one I'm interested in.
I've been too busy to date.

nodes.text: Howard chokes on the sip of coffee he's taken.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops, I didn't mean to surprise him... I probably should've taken it easy first...
Howard stirs his coffee.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just couldn't stay away, I guess.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Having you in the picture will just make it harder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Girls don't really like it when guys hover around them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe this is a good time for you to hang out with other people, do other things...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then when $ZOE figures everything out... You'll be a better guy. Maybe even the guy for her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It seems like the opposite of what I should be doing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, you don't have to take my advice...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just the guy with the really hot girlfriend.
Owen turns and sees Emily. She sits down next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'd say you're pretty lucky.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's going on over here?
Owen gives Ben a significant look.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just talking... What's up with you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've been chatting with the swim team... We're all excited about our swim retreat coming up in a few days...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right, the one with you and a bunch of hot swimmer guys in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're exaggerating! Remember, my dad will be there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for that...
They laugh, while Owen broods on the porch, trying to keep images of $ZOE and Howard together out of his head...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
At a nearby cafe, Howard and Zoe are catching up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...And so I spent my first night there explaining to the dean why there was a fencing foil in the University founder's statue!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe they're making you learn how to fence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't picture you as much of a sword-fighter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Neither can my fencing master, funnily enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But aside from that... Do you like Kingston University?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kingston's certainly keeping me busy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Since I got into the Kingston King program, they expect me to be a real school leader...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And what that really means is making a lot of speeches and showing people around campus.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a great way to meet people.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I already met some people who have taken up the major I want to pursue...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And one of them was a TA for the biology class I'm taking!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Majors? TAs? It all sounds so... College-y.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, it's not all like that! I've been going to some awesome campus parties.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We had one the first week inside the Kingston Observatory.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We danced inside a huge dome with all the stars and planets projected on top of us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds amazing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... It does sound amazing, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, classes, speeches, and parties... You `are` busy...
nodes.text_bbcode: So, classes, speeches, and parties... You [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] busy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are a couple things I really want to know...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What should I ask first?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the last thing I want is for $ZOE to think that I've given up on her.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I want to be there for her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And it's great that you care about her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But honestly, $ZOE's probably confused enough as it is.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hate to say it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But Howard's already got a leg up on you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, it's nothing against you personally. But while you and Zoe have good chemistry...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She and Howard have a history.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I take it you're not just talking about our class schedules.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Honestly, she's probably really confused right now.
Owen walks off.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, ladies... I'm up for a tour of a private greenhouse...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Or a `private` boat ride with both of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or a [color=#e23b3b][i]private[/i][/color] boat ride with both of you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Forget it, Spencer...
In front of Paige's house, Owen sits alone, staring out into the clear night sky...
Some footsteps approach him from behind.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, man. You doing okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Good enough. Just needed some space to think.
Ben sits down next to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...About $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... I thought she'd want to be at this party... At least, you know to scope out the competition.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...You do know she's off with Howard, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. I do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait, why do you sound worried about that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...I don't know. Maybe it's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just... The thing you have to understand about $ZOE and Howard is that they were just the `perfect` couple...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's just... The thing you have to understand about $ZOE and Howard is that they were just the [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect[/i][/color] couple...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When Howard left, and they broke up... It was kind of like she lost half of herself, you know? She was really in a bad place.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But then you came along...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This last week was the happiest I've ever seen her since the break up... Because for the first time, she seemed like she was really moving on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And now Howard's back.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He is... And I have `no idea` what that's going to do to her.
nodes.text_bbcode: He is... And I have [color=#e23b3b][i]no idea[/i][/color] what that's going to do to her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, that makes it tough for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This entire week... I thought we had something going, but now...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where do I stand with her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't envy you. You're in a tough spot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have any advice?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. I think your best shot is to leave her alone right now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't do that! It feels like I'm...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Flowers, swans, lakes... Blech.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh no! That's awful!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. It runs in my family. My grandma Betty... She `sees` a flower, and she starts sneezing...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yep. It runs in my family. My grandma Betty... She [color=#e23b3b][i]sees[/i][/color] a flower, and she starts sneezing...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You poor thing!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Geez, Nicole, get a clue... I don't think Owen's `interested.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, Nicole, get a clue... I don't think Owen's [color=#3b78e2][i]interested.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're allergic to nature, but you play on the football field? With the grass and dirt?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: If you didn't want to hang out, you could've just said so, instead of making up a lame excuse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should've been more upfront...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hope you understand...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's nothing against you two, but...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I get it... You're into someone else...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes... Yes, I am...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, if you ever get tired of waiting...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Find me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Or me!
Owen raises his soda.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `To Twin Branches!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]To Twin Branches![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The football players crush their soda cans together as the crowd cheers!
Owen sees the happy faces around him, but his smile fades after the crowd disbands.
Spencer punches Owen in the shoulder. Owen rubs his arm.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We played a great game! We're `winners!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We played a great game! We're [color=#e23b3b][i]winners![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've been smiling so much, my `face` hurts!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've been smiling so much, my [color=#e23b3b][i]face[/i][/color] hurts!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `YEAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YEAH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah!
Spencer notices Owen's serious face.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, man... You look like you just ate a bad pizza. Don't you want to party?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not exactly in the partying mood... Hey, have you seen $ZOE around?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. But I `do` see Hannah and Nicole...
nodes.text_bbcode: Nope. But I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] see Hannah and Nicole...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not quite what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, Owen... I'm going to try boating around Paige's lake...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Do you want to come with me? There's room for `two` on each swan boat...
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you want to come with me? There's room for [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] on each swan boat...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I was just going to ask if he wanted to go see Paige's `private` greenhouse with `me...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute... I was just going to ask if he wanted to go see Paige's [color=#3b78e2][i]private[/i][/color] greenhouse with [color=#3b78e2][i]me...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're lucky to have us!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This guy! So modest! `You're` the man, man!
nodes.text_bbcode: This guy! So modest! [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] the man, man!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Woo! Yeah, football!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Go, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if she didn't take me in, I wouldn't be here.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I think it's sweet! Family's important!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Me too! Go, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Step right up! Come on over! We have an awesome dunk tank!
Students notice $ZOE and the dunk tank and draw near.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First person to step up gets to dunk Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought I was safe!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You just made yourself the biggest target of all!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I see...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You'd better watch out, or you're going to be the first to get dunked!

nodes.text: $ZOE yells at the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't come closer! Step away!
When Dex nears the booth to inspect the dunk tank, $ZOE turns to him and shouts.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go step off a cliff!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoa, okay!
Dex moves quickly away from the booth, as Howard puts a hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're going to need to work on your carnival barking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, you just scared away that big group of girls wandering by...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you were pretty rude to those guys over there. I don't know that anyone's going to want to get close now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really messed up, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course not. Look, Owen and I will go out and bring people back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It'll be fine.
Some time later...
$ZOE stands by her still-empty booth when she sees Howard and Owen come back by themselves.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, so we have some bad news.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We didn't find anyone. Most people have either left the school... Or they're at Paige's booth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?
$ZOE sees Paige's booth overcrowded with students! Paige spots $ZOE and flashes her a triumphant smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks for your support, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... This is a `disaster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no... This is a [color=#3b78e2][i]disaster![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll tell you what's a disaster.
Taylor comes up to inspect $ZOE's booth.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This booth hasn't made a cent since it opened! This is a fund`raiser` not a fund-`downer!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This booth hasn't made a cent since it opened! This is a fund[color=#3b78e2][i]raiser[/i][/color] not a fund-[color=#3b78e2][i]downer![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but Paige won this round.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She may have only sold `one` cupcake, but it's way more progress than you've made...
nodes.text_bbcode: She may have only sold [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] cupcake, but it's way more progress than you've made...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you just give me another chance...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE. You only get one shot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See you around.
$ZOE sadly looks on as Paige celebrates with her friends, coming to terms with the simple fact...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How much to dunk Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $10 for two balloons!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Done!
Spencer climbs into the dunk seat, and Nicole throws one balloon...
It misses!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You throw like a girl!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're not getting away with an insult as sad as `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not getting away with an insult as sad as [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nicole throws the balloon at the target!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.text: The crowd cheers as Spencer falls!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Whoo! Go, Nicole, go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's up next?
And for the rest of the afternoon, $ZOE and Howard receive a steady stream of customers...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Let's see if I can knock Jacob off his high horse!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who wants to dunk Phil?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: My pleasure!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.text: An hour later, the fundraiser winds down, and Taylor comes up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I had Brendan do some calculations... And congratulations! You're the one who's made the most money!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about Paige and her cupcakes?
Paige stands at her booth, yelling angrily at the people in her booth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who can't afford a cupcake? I lowered the price to five hundred!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Still too steep for my blood...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Seriously. We're `actresses,` not banks.
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]actresses,[/i][/color] not banks.

nodes.text: Paige looks over and sees her two friends from Monarch Prep come up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great! People with money! Give me a thousand dollars, and I'll give you this delicious cupcake...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Dollars? Can you take credit?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Yeah, I didn't bring any cash.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you `mean` you didn't bring any cash? I don't have anything to swipe your credit cards with!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you [color=#3b78e2][i]mean[/i][/color] you didn't bring any cash? I don't have anything to swipe your credit cards with!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Don't look at me. I haven't touched paper money in five years...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What about `you`, Prissy?
nodes.text_bbcode: What about [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color], Prissy?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You think I just carry a thousand dollars on me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! You did that one time you bought that Charmani dress!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That was an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, I was really counting on you two!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, as you can see, Paige has some problems of her own...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So from here on out... I give you the full support of my Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor!
As $ZOE skips away, she runs right into Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Looks like things really came together, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't have been able to do it without your idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you so much.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem... But I wasn't the one who brought the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's always been good at pulling stuff together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't he great?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. A real stand-up guy.
$ZOE notices Howard packing up the truck.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Owen, but I have to catch Howard before he leaves...
$ZOE taps Howard on the shoulder. When he turns to her, she gives him a big hug!
As she leans back to smile up at him, Owen walks away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what was that for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, thank you so much for bringing this over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't have raised any money without your help...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We really are a `great` team...
nodes.text_bbcode: We really are a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] team...

nodes.text: $ZOE looks down at the ground, but Howard catches her chin and tips it up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I would've done this for you any day. I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still in love with you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sounds like you know what you're doing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I still don't know how to turn all that into entertainment for a booth tomorrow....

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, we got balloons, water fights, playing games...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got it. Your booth can be a big `game` of `spray the balloon animal with water`.
nodes.text_bbcode: I got it. Your booth can be a big [color=#e23b3b][i]game[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]spray the balloon animal with water[/i][/color].

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like, a 'Wild Water World' type thing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Exactly...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or not... I don't even know how to make balloon animals!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait! I got it... We could make a game like the ones they have at the fair!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hate to say it... But I think your definition of fun is different from everyone else's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I did horribly. The minute you asked, I couldn't think of anything good.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's okay. We can keep going. At least we know what our backup plans are.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, wait, I have it... All our talk just reminded me of the fair.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There were several booths with games for people to win prizes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I used to be pretty pro at ring toss...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha! I could totally do something like that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I can make a booth where people hurl water balloons at targets for prizes?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sounds pretty fun to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I like it a lot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you so much for talking this out with me... I was so worried!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Any time. And if you need any help setting everything up, I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't turn down the help...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you need help with?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!
$ZOE and Owen find Howard behind them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you two planning over here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm setting up a carnival game for a fundraising activity tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to need some help getting everything done...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd be happy to step up. We can start picking up the supplies right now, if you want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, if you don't mind! It would take a load off my mind if we got that out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great.
At that moment, people start coming up to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Howard! It's good to see you, man.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We've missed you. We could've used you at the game...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You guys are doing all right. I saw the win. Looks like the team's in good hands.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard! How's my college bro doing? Please tell me it's awesome.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's beyond awesome.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I knew it... You can't have too much fun without me, understand?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wouldn't dream of it...
Well-wishers swarm Howard, greeting him and giving him pats on the back. Howard catches up with them briefly until...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was thinking we could grab lunch at that panini place you love, and then we'll stop by the store?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Perfect!
Owen watches them laugh and joke as they walk off.
Around him conversation buzzes...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That guy is `great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That guy is [color=#e23b3b][i]great.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That guy is `hot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That guy is [color=#3b78e2][i]hot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE must be so `happy`...
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE must be so [color=#3b78e2][i]happy[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Her new guy even `looks` like Howard!
nodes.text_bbcode: Her new guy even [color=#3b78e2][i]looks[/i][/color] like Howard!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: They are, like, the `perfect couple`...
nodes.text_bbcode: They are, like, the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect couple[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I bet this is really killing you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh?
Paige steps around Owen and shoots him a pleasant smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Howard's back... $ZOE's gone with him...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't be her lapdog anymore. Isn't that too bad?
She laughs as she walks into the cafeteria. Owen tries to ignore her...
But finds that he can't.
The next afternoon, $ZOE stands in front of her table at the fundraiser.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come play balloon toss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only $5 for two balloons!
People stop to look at the barrel of water balloons, but pass them up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one wants to try to win a stuffed animal?
Nearby, Paige's bakery booth is filled with interested people.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I had all these shipped overnight from the finest patisserie in Paris.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: How divine!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's like being in France!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And these cupcakes over here were made with the most expensive chocolate in Switzerland...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It `smells` like money...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]smells[/i][/color] like money...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And `these` cupcakes are dusted with gold...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]these[/i][/color] cupcakes are dusted with gold...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Shiny!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: How much?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: One cupcake for $1000!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Paige is selling cupcakes at those rates, she'll beat me easily!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should raise my prices...
Owen approaches $ZOE's booth.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm stepping right up... What do I get to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For the fine rate of $5, you get two water balloons and two tries to peg one of the targets over there...
$ZOE points at the brightly colored, hand-painted targets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you hit one, you can win a stuffed animal.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, this looks great. You must have worked really hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, but water balloons aren't nearly as enticing as gold-encrusted cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's crazy! If anything, gold is the last thing I want to be putting into my mouth...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And yet...
$ZOE waves a hand at her empty booth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The only person who's tried is Amanda, and she screamed when she thought she killed a stuffed animal by mistake...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know what you need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A miracle?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A new spin! A way to attract people over... You should...
But Owen's suggestion dies when a truck with a large dunk tank rumbles onto the field and parks right next to $ZOE's booth!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?
Howard jumps down from the truck bed and gestures to the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your water balloon concept got me thinking about crazy water stuff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then I remembered my friends at Centerscore U telling me how they'd used a dunk tank at their last frat party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks brand new!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had to wash it `seven` times... You `really` don't want to know why...
nodes.text_bbcode: I had to wash it [color=#e23b3b][i]seven[/i][/color] times... You [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] don't want to know why...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's all ready to go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who am I going to dunk though? There's only one of me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I made a few calls. You're going to have a fleet of State Champions to dunk...
Some of the football team comes over.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: This will be fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dunk tank! Dunk tank!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! This is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! People will `love` this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! People will [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to get them here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you're a cheerleader... And now you have something to cheer about!
$ZOE steps up and yells...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's throw out a couple more...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How about...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's try a different direction...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think I've ever made one of those before...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you're missing out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Watching paint dry?
At lunch, $ZOE walks out of her class, feeling deflated.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Owen... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You look down. What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor wants me to run a fundraising booth tomorrow, but I don't have any ideas...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've been thinking about it all morning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm totally blanking! What would be fun for people? A disco ball? A pony show?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to decide now if I'm going to have to buy supplies today!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think a disco ball by itself in a booth is going to be much fun for people...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? Do you have any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know that sometimes if you get stuck, it helps listing as many ideas as you can.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why don't you try listing some activities that people find fun? Just throw out whatever you think of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! People enjoy...
And for the next hour, they talk like old friends...
They talk of life at Kingston and life at Twin Branches...
Of Howard's college courses and of $ZOE's school life...
Until at last, the evening winds down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Twin Branches do you miss the most?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's hard to say... I definitely miss my family...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My mom, my dad... Kay, Kel, and Kara...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've really missed you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you were such a big part of my life... And we were a really great team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was hard for me to move forward...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I had to force myself to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Me too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm glad we can still talk... The way we used to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, it's getting late... I should go.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk you out.
They exit into the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd like to hang out with you again. What are you doing for lunch tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The usual... I'll be in the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where the meat is so scary that they call it 'mystery mystery'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about I take you out for lunch? I can pick you up, we'll grab something quick, and I'll get you back before seventh period.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wouldn't mind dropping by the school anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, okay! Sure!
They stop by her car.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zoe, it's... It's really good to see you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's really good to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll pick you up at noon?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep.
They stare at one another.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Well, there are girls at Kingston...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can only imagine...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I haven't met any girl worth spending time with...
Howard looks at $ZOE with an emotion she can't identify.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about you? Have you started dating anyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...
$ZOE's mind wanders to the football field an hour earlier...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So $ZOE, now that this is all over...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you think we could finally get some time to just hang out together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Because I'd really like to get to know you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?
$ZOE focuses on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... No, I haven't...

options.label: There's no one I'm interested in.
I've been too busy to date.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But seriously... I'm on a break.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wouldn't your school break be a little later? Like, around Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it's Kingston's way of celebrating the, uh... Vernal Equinox.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of weird... But hey. East Coast schools, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Those East Coast schools are all so... Strange?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha... I just meant that Kingston has peculiar traditions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I bet...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like, there's one legend in the school...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: About this `secret` society that all the elite members become part of.
nodes.text_bbcode: About this [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society that all the elite members become part of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How much to dunk Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $10 for two balloons!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Done!
Spencer climbs into the dunk seat, and Nicole throws one balloon...
It misses!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You throw like a girl!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're not getting away with an insult as sad as `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not getting away with an insult as sad as [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nicole throws the balloon at the target!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.text: The crowd cheers as Spencer falls!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Whoo! Go, Nicole, go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's up next?
And for the rest of the afternoon, $ZOE and Howard receive a steady stream of customers...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Let's see if I can knock Jacob off his high horse!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who wants to dunk Phil?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: My pleasure!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.text: An hour later, the fundraiser winds down, and Taylor comes up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I had Brendan do some calculations... And congratulations! You're the one who's made the most money!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about Paige and her cupcakes?
Paige stands at her booth, yelling angrily at the people in her booth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who can't afford a cupcake? I lowered the price to five hundred!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Still too steep for my blood...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Seriously. We're `actresses,` not banks.
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]actresses,[/i][/color] not banks.

nodes.text: Paige looks over and sees her two friends from Monarch Prep come up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great! People with money! Give me a thousand dollars, and I'll give you this delicious cupcake...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Dollars? Can you take credit?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Yeah, I didn't bring any cash.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you `mean` you didn't bring any cash? I don't have anything to swipe your credit cards with!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you [color=#3b78e2][i]mean[/i][/color] you didn't bring any cash? I don't have anything to swipe your credit cards with!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Don't look at me. I haven't touched paper money in five years...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What about `you`, Prissy?
nodes.text_bbcode: What about [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color], Prissy?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You think I just carry a thousand dollars on me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! You did that one time you bought that Charmani dress!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That was an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, I was really counting on you two!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, as you can see, Paige has some problems of her own...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So from here on out... I give you the full support of my Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor!
As $ZOE skips away, she runs right into Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Looks like things really came together, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't have been able to do it without your idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you so much.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem... But I wasn't the one who brought the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's always been good at pulling stuff together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't he great?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. A real stand-up guy.
$ZOE notices Howard packing up the truck.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Owen, but I have to catch Howard before he leaves...
$ZOE taps Howard on the shoulder. When he turns to her, she gives him a big hug!
As she leans back to smile up at him, Owen walks away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what was that for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, thank you so much for bringing this over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't have raised any money without your help...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We really are a `great` team...
nodes.text_bbcode: We really are a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] team...

nodes.text: $ZOE looks down at the ground, but Howard catches her chin and tips it up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I would've done this for you any day. I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still in love with you.

nodes.text: The next afternoon, $ZOE stands in front of her table at the fundraiser.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come play balloon toss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only $5 for two balloons!
People stop to look at the barrel of water balloons, but pass them up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one wants to try to win a stuffed animal?
Nearby, Paige's bakery booth is filled with interested people.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I had all these shipped overnight from the finest patisserie in Paris.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: How divine!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's like being in France!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And these cupcakes over here were made with the most expensive chocolate in Switzerland...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It `smells` like money...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]smells[/i][/color] like money...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And `these` cupcakes are dusted with gold...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]these[/i][/color] cupcakes are dusted with gold...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Shiny!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: How much?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: One cupcake for $1000!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Paige is selling cupcakes at those rates, she'll beat me easily!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should raise my prices...
Owen approaches $ZOE's booth.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm stepping right up... What do I get to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For the fine rate of $5, you get two water balloons and two tries to peg one of the targets over there...
$ZOE points at the brightly colored, hand-painted targets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you hit one, you can win a stuffed animal.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, this looks great. You must have worked really hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, but water balloons aren't nearly as enticing as gold-encrusted cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's crazy! If anything, gold is the last thing I want to be putting into my mouth...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And yet...
$ZOE waves a hand at her empty booth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The only person who's tried is Amanda, and she screamed when she thought she killed a stuffed animal by mistake...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know what you need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A miracle?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A new spin! A way to attract people over... You should...
But Owen's suggestion dies when a truck with a large dunk tank rumbles onto the field and parks right next to $ZOE's booth!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?
Howard jumps down from the truck bed and gestures to the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your water balloon concept got me thinking about crazy water stuff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then I remembered my friends at Centerscore U telling me how they'd used a dunk tank at their last frat party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks brand new!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had to wash it `seven` times... You `really` don't want to know why...
nodes.text_bbcode: I had to wash it [color=#e23b3b][i]seven[/i][/color] times... You [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] don't want to know why...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's all ready to go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who am I going to dunk though? There's only one of me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I made a few calls. You're going to have a fleet of State Champions to dunk...
Some of the football team comes over.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: This will be fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dunk tank! Dunk tank!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! This is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! People will `love` this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! People will [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to get them here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you're a cheerleader... And now you have something to cheer about!
$ZOE steps up and yells...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Owen... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You look down. What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor wants me to run a fundraising booth tomorrow, but I don't have any ideas...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've been thinking about it all morning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm totally blanking! What would be fun for people? A disco ball? A pony show?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to decide now if I'm going to have to buy supplies today!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think a disco ball by itself in a booth is going to be much fun for people...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? Do you have any ideas?
